posts.author: KLoaec
posts.name: Kevin Loaec
posts.text:
IMPORTANTIn the next couple of days, a new shitcoin will fork off Bitcoin. It is a big security risk for people who just believe they will get an "airdrop" and want to sell it, to get more bitcoin.
I will write more about it, but here is the TLDR:

posts.author: KLoaec
posts.name: Kevin Loaec
posts.text:
If someone comes to you and is like "hey, i'm buying your bdash for 0.1 btc each! Wanna trade?"
Wow, sounds great no? 10% more on your bitcoin stack!
 NO! If you send your bdash to this person, they can also TAKE ALL YOUR BITCOIN. This is called a replay attack.

posts.author: KLoaec
posts.name: Kevin Loaec
posts.text: The 2 chains will diverge on Saturday. But they keep the EXACT SAME rules, there is no "op_return" change or anything like that at first. Meaning you cannot protect your coins by sending them with a BIP110 invalid transaction, at least not in the near future.

posts.author: KLoaec
posts.name: Kevin Loaec
posts.text: It's unlikely the bdash shitcoin will have any value, but people can try to scam you buy offering you a "too good to pass" offer like in my example above. DO NOT TAKE THESE OFFERS if you don't know what you are doing. You will get scammed of all your bitcoins.
